quests.instruction: Which word has the long a sound spelled ai?
quests.hint: Look for the two letters a and i side by side.
quests.explanation: In “rain”, the letters ai work together to make the long a sound. “Ran” has short a and “ray” spells long a with ay.

quests.instruction: The letters ay usually come at the end of a word. Which word ends with the long a sound spelled ay?
quests.hint: Check the last two letters of each word.
quests.explanation: “Play” ends with ay. “Plain” has ai in the middle and “plan” has short a.
quests.funFact: English words almost never end with the letters ai. At the end of a word, the long a sound is usually spelled ay.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? tr__n — it runs on tracks.
quests.hint: Say the word you mean. Which vowel team fits the middle?
quests.explanation: “Train” has ai in the middle, making the long a sound.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? d__ — the sun comes up each one.
quests.hint: The word ends with the long a sound. Which team belongs at the end?
quests.explanation: “Day” ends with ay. ai is not used at the end of words.
quests.funFact: Day, play, stay, say, way and may all end with ay.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long a sound spelled ay?
quests.hint: Look at the end of each word.
quests.explanation: “Stay” ends with ay. “Snail” has ai and “stand” has short a.

quests.instruction: Which spelling is right? You can ___ with a ball.
quests.hint: Ay is the spelling that goes at the end.
quests.explanation: “Play” is spelled with ay at the end. The other two are not real words.

quests.instruction: Which word has two e letters making the long e sound?
quests.hint: Look for two e letters in a row.
quests.explanation: “Tree” has ee, which makes the long e sound. “Trip” has short i and “tray” has long a.
quests.funFact: Tree, bee, see, free and green all use ee for long e.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? b__ — a buzzing insect that makes honey.
quests.hint: Say the word for a buzzing insect. Which vowel team do you hear?
quests.explanation: “Bee” ends with ee for the long e sound.

quests.instruction: Which word does NOT have the long e sound?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen to the vowel.
quests.explanation: “Seed” and “week” have ee and long e. “Step” has short e.

quests.instruction: Which word spells long e with the letters ea?
quests.hint: Look for the letters e and a side by side.
quests.explanation: “Leaf” has ea, making the long e sound. “Loaf” has oa, which makes long o.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? s__ — it is salty and blue.
quests.hint: Say the word for the big salty water. Which team fits?
quests.explanation: “Sea” is spelled with ea. “See” sounds the same, but it means to look with your eyes.
quests.funFact: Sea and see sound exactly the same but have different spellings and meanings.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same vowel sound as “clean”?
quests.hint: Say clean and listen to the vowel. Which word matches?
quests.explanation: “Clean” and “dream” both have ea for the long e sound.

quests.instruction: Both ee and ea can make the long e sound. Which word uses ee?
quests.hint: Look at the letters in the middle of each word.
quests.explanation: “Green” uses ee. “Clean” and “leaf” use ea.

quests.instruction: Which word uses ea for the long e sound?
quests.hint: Find the word with an e and an a next to each other.
quests.explanation: “Eat” uses ea. “Feet” and “seed” use ee.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? sl__p — you do this at night.
quests.hint: Say the word. Two of these teams make long e, but only one makes a real word.
quests.explanation: “Sleep” is spelled with ee. “Sleap” is not a word.
quests.funFact: Because ee and ea sound the same, readers learn to remember which spelling goes with which word.

quests.instruction: Find the word where oa makes the long o sound.
quests.hint: Look for the letters o and a side by side.
quests.explanation: “Boat” has oa, which makes the long o sound.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? s__p — you wash your hands with it.
quests.hint: Say the word for something used to get clean.
quests.explanation: “Soap” has oa in the middle.
quests.funFact: In boat, soap and road, the letters oa work together to make one vowel sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same vowel sound as “coat”?
quests.hint: Say coat and listen to the vowel. Which word matches?
quests.explanation: “Coat” and “road” both have oa and the long o sound. “Rod” and “rid” have short vowels.

quests.instruction: Which word ends with the long o sound spelled ow?
quests.hint: Check how each word finishes. Which one ends with the letters ow?
quests.explanation: “Snow” ends with ow, which makes the long o sound here.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? gr__ — a plant does this when you water it.
quests.hint: Say the word. The ending is the long o sound.
quests.explanation: “Grow” is spelled with ow. “Groa” is not a word.
quests.funFact: The letters ow can say two different sounds. In snow and grow it says long o, as in “oh”.

quests.instruction: Which word ends with the long o sound, like “blow”?
quests.hint: Look for the word whose last sound is “oh”.
quests.explanation: “Slow” and “blow” both end with ow, which says long o.

quests.instruction: Which word hides the long i sound inside the letters igh?
quests.hint: Look for the three letters igh together.
quests.explanation: “Night” has igh. The gh is silent and the i says its name.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? l__t — a lamp gives you this.
quests.hint: Say the word for what a lamp gives. Which team fits?
quests.explanation: “Light” is spelled with igh in the middle.

quests.instruction: Five letters, but how many sounds? Look at “night”.
quests.hint: Remember that igh is one sound.
quests.explanation: “Night” has 3 sounds: /n/ /ī/ /t/. The three letters igh work together as a single vowel sound.
quests.funFact: Long ago, the gh in words like night and light was pronounced. Today it is silent.

quests.instruction: Which word is the odd one out because of its vowel sound?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen to the vowel. Two words match.
quests.explanation: “Rain” and “tray” both have long a. “Seed” has long e.
quests.funFact: Rain and tray have the same vowel sound even though they use different spellings, ai and ay.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long o sound, spelled with a vowel team?
quests.hint: Look for the letters oa.
quests.explanation: “Toast” has oa for long o. “Train” has long a and “treat” has long e.

quests.instruction: Which letters spell the long i sound in “bright”?
quests.hint: Look at the middle of the word.
quests.explanation: “Bright” has igh. The other two teams spell different sounds.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long a sound but is NOT spelled with ai or ay?
quests.hint: Look for the word without a vowel team.
quests.explanation: “Cake” spells long a with a silent e, not ai or ay. “Rain” uses ai and “play” uses ay.
quests.funFact: English has many ways to spell long a. The patterns a_e, ai and ay are three of the most common.

quests.instruction: Which pair of words has the same vowel sound?
quests.hint: Say both words in each pair and listen to the vowels.
quests.explanation: “Boat” and “note” both have long o, but spell it differently, with oa and o_e.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with the blend sn and has the long o sound spelled ow?
quests.hint: Check both the start and the end of each word.
quests.explanation: “Snow” starts with sn and ends with ow for long o. “Snail” has ai and “snap” has short a.
